intro.title: Selected Software Development Work
intro.description: These case studies summarize practical implementation work across React applications, Java backend systems, integrations, maintainability and business-facing software. Client-sensitive work can be discussed as anonymized examples.

workWith.title: Technologies and ecosystems ICT Services works with
workWith.note: The logos below represent platforms, tools, and ecosystems used in hands-on development work. They do not imply direct partnerships or client relationships.

ictWebsite.name: ICT Services Landing Platform
ictWebsite.description: A modern React-based landing platform for ICT Services featuring reusable content configuration, legal compliance sections, and a functional contact workflow.
ictWebsite.problem: The brand needed a focused software development website with clear service positioning and a simple contact path.
ictWebsite.solution: Built a React landing experience with reusable content, legal pages, blog routing and an EmailJS contact workflow.
ictWebsite.result: A maintainable public site that communicates Salesforce, React and Java development services clearly.

dreamAnalyzerAI.name: Dream Analyzer AI
dreamAnalyzerAI.description: A full-stack AI-powered web application that analyzes user-described dreams and generates multiple interpretations using OpenAI API.
dreamAnalyzerAI.problem: Users needed a structured way to submit open-ended text and receive useful AI-generated interpretations.
dreamAnalyzerAI.solution: Delivered a full-stack application with a React interface, Java Spring Boot backend and OpenAI API integration.
dreamAnalyzerAI.result: A working AI web application with separated frontend and backend responsibilities and deployable cloud hosting.

patternHasher.name: Pattern Hasher Library
patternHasher.description: A lightweight Java hashing library implementing a custom pattern-based transformation algorithm, designed for consistent and efficient string hashing across applications.
patternHasher.problem: Java applications needed a small reusable hashing utility with predictable behavior.
patternHasher.solution: Created a lightweight Java library with a pattern-based transformation approach and focused implementation.
patternHasher.result: A reusable package that can be inspected, extended and integrated into Java-based projects.

travelAgencyWebsite.name: Travel Agency Web Experience
travelAgencyWebsite.description: A PHP-based web experience simulating a travel agency platform, focused on structured content delivery and responsive UI design.
travelAgencyWebsite.problem: A content-heavy travel concept needed a structured, responsive web presentation.
travelAgencyWebsite.solution: Implemented a PHP and frontend experience with organized content sections and responsive styling.
travelAgencyWebsite.result: A clear browser-based experience demonstrating practical content delivery and UI structure.

snakeGame.name: Snake Desktop Game
snakeGame.description: A classic Snake game implemented as a desktop application using Java Swing, focusing on event-driven programming and UI rendering.
snakeGame.problem: A desktop game concept required event-driven input handling and reliable screen rendering.
snakeGame.solution: Built a Java Swing application with keyboard controls, game state updates and UI rendering.
snakeGame.result: A functional desktop application demonstrating Java UI programming and application state management.
